sentences: I measure the water level at the pier every hour to track the high tide.
I check the tide table each morning to see when low tide will occur.
I record the time of slack water between the ebb and flood currents.
I note the tidal range by subtracting the low water mark from the high water mark.
I observe the spring tide when the moon is full or new and the range is largest.
I calculate the neap tide period when the sun and moon are at right angles.
I track the semidiurnal pattern of two high tides and two low tides each day.
I log the diurnal tide when only one high and one low occur in a day.
I monitor the mixed tide pattern with unequal highs and lows at this location.
I measure the tidal amplitude as half the difference between high and low water.
I check the tidal phase by comparing predicted and observed high tide times.
I record the tidal bore as it travels up the river at the incoming tide.
I observe the tidal current direction changing from flood to ebb at slack water.
I use a tide gauge to record the water level every six minutes.
I note the tidal datum as the reference level for all depth measurements.
I calculate the tidal cycle length of about twelve hours and twenty-five minutes.
I check the moon's phase to predict the timing of the next spring tide.
I record the sun's gravitational pull adding to the moon's effect during spring tides.
I measure the tidal flat exposure time when the water recedes at low tide.
I observe the tidal pool left behind on the beach after the tide goes out.
